title: What does this path prepare you to submit?
prompt: Pick the accurate statement about the competency submission.

options.text: Five technical accreditations, a Glean-delivered workshop, and five production-ready agents with evidence.
options.feedback: Correct. The path builds the skills; the submission needs accreditations, the workshop, the agents, and the evidence artefacts.

options.text: A single reference agent and a slide deck.
options.feedback: No. Five production-ready agents are required, each with documented requirements and an architecture review.

options.text: Only the completion of these eleven modules.
options.feedback: Not quite. Coursework is necessary but the competency also requires built agents and validation.
